limits: Two windows from the currently running stationary firmware, no interruption or actuator commands. Local UF2 hash identifies intended file, not flash readback. Packet timestamps are serialization time; this is not isolated AP/radio timing.
interpretation: Paired 101 frames reached TCP and WebSocket within 0..1 ms; multi-second stalls are upstream of the local WebSocket link. Frames were generated every 400 ms; missing sequences caused observed 800..2000 ms generation gaps. Six missing sequence numbers and seven publish errors were recorded in the first window.
